pipeline.name: pl_fab001_runtime_orchestration
pipeline.description: Bounded Fabric-native orchestration for the FAB001 proof path. Runs the loader notebook after repo-side approval and keeps runtime governance inside the platform.

runtime_sequence.description: Repo-side approval has already promoted the bounded raw-like Bronze input package.
Fabric lands the approved Bronze input from OneLake Files into Delta tables.
The loader notebook cleans, normalizes, and conforms the Bronze input inside Fabric Silver.
The loader notebook derives bounded Gold serving tables downstream of Silver.
Runtime governance records whether a bounded Fabric public serving extract was produced.
The governance notebook materializes control-table evidence inside the Lakehouse.

public_serving_extract.description: The active public-site source is the bounded Fabric serving extract. Runtime orchestration must still record serving-extract status and retain repo_mirror_transitional only as an honest fallback when no extract evidence is available.

governance_notebook.name: nb_fab001_runtime_governance
governance_notebook.description: Materialize bounded runtime governance control tables inside the FAB001 Lakehouse.
